annotations.title: Find a lab near a ZIP code

description: Nearest Hera partner labs near a US ZIP code for a semen analysis, a post-vasectomy check, a semen culture, a sperm DNA fragmentation test or sperm freezing (cryopreservation), with the price, where it is paid, and a link to order online. Use for "where can I get a sperm test near me" questions.

test.description: semen_analysis (the default: a standard sperm/fertility test), post_vasectomy (a sperm check after a vasectomy), semen_culture (checking for infection), dna_fragmentation (sperm DNA damage), or sperm_freezing (banking a sample).
